findings.message: T001 description is non-executable: it names only the infrastructure generally, omits a concrete target file or symbol, and has no AC/IN/CN/spec anchor.
T002 description is non-executable: it names only the CLI stack, omits a concrete target file or symbol, and has no AC/IN/CN/spec anchor.
T003 description is non-executable: although it names configuration and cargo-make areas, it lacks concrete target files or symbols and has no AC/IN/CN/spec anchor.
T004 description is non-executable: it names CI and cargo-make generally, omits concrete target files or symbols, and has no AC/IN/CN/spec anchor.

The T001 description restates upstream behavior and rationale (default-off dependency exclusion and opt-in availability) instead of using only target + operation + anchor. Cite knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md.

The T002 description restates the feature-off fail-closed contract and feature-on behavior in prose instead of using only target + operation + anchor. Cite knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md.

The T003 description restates configurable defaults, cleanup behavior, and the prohibition on implicit constants in prose instead of using only target + operation + anchor. Cite knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md.

The T004 description restates CI feature policy and the lightweight default binary policy in prose instead of using only target + operation + anchor. Cite knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md.

Plan section S1 restates implementation ordering and feature-off behavior in prose rather than limiting the section description to executable planning references; this is upstream restatement under the impl-plan policy. Cite knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md.

Plan section S2 restates the configurable cache/cleanup behavior in prose rather than limiting the section description to executable planning references; this is upstream restatement under the impl-plan policy. Cite knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md.

Plan section S3 restates the feature-boundary sequencing rationale in prose rather than limiting the section description to executable planning references; this is upstream restatement under the impl-plan policy. Cite knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md.

T001 の変更境界は feature-off build を成立させられません。対象を `libs/infrastructure/src/{lib.rs,semantic_dup/**}` に限定していますが、`dry_check/dry_write_driver.rs`、`dry_check/dry_write_driver/persistent_index.rs`、`dry_check/corpus_meta.rs`、`track/fixpoint_resolve_driver.rs` などが cfg gate 対象 API を無条件参照しています。これらの consumer を gate または feature-off 実装へ切り替える対象も T001（または先行タスク）に明記しないと、実装者が変更境界を発明する必要があり AC-01 の feature-off build coverage を通せません。
`plan.summary` が存在せず、GO-01〜GO-04 の task traceability がありません。goal は `task-coverage.json` の対象外なので、scope policy が要求する通り summary に GO-01→T001/T002、GO-02→T002、GO-03→T003、GO-04→T004 のような対応を記録してください。

T002 は `cli_composition / DupIndexBuildInput` に帰属していますが、CURRENT の `cli_composition-types.json` および type-signals に同 entry は存在しません。そのため `bin/sotp task-contract coverage` は `InvalidEntryRef` で BLOCKED になります。stale な帰属を除くか、type-designer 経由で必要な catalogue entry を復元して CURRENT catalogue と一致させてください。

`cli_composition::DupIndexBuildInput` is a lightweight DTO containing only two `PathBuf` fields, yet it is the sole input DTO marked `delete`; the sibling semantic-dup input DTOs remain. `IN-01` only grounds gating infrastructure's heavyweight dependencies and does not justify removing this DTO, contradicting the briefing's explicit statement that input DTOs remain outside the catalogue. Remove this tombstone.
